tactics: rcases xs with _ | ⟨x, _ | ⟨y, t⟩⟩ <;> simp only [List.dropLast, List.head] at h ⊢
match xs, h with | x :: y :: t, _ => rfl
cases xs with | nil => simp [List.dropLast] at h | cons x t => cases t with | nil => simp [List.dropLast] at h | cons y t => rfl
rcases xs with _ | ⟨x, _ | ⟨y, t⟩⟩ <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; exact h rfl)
